# NNN: Title

Decision status: Proposed | Accepted.

## Context

What situation required a decision. State the facts and the constraints; do not record
implementation progress.

## Decision

### D1. First decision

What is decided and why.

### D2. Second decision

What is decided and why.

## Consequences

What follows from the decision, including what is removed or no longer allowed.

## Non-goals

What this decision does not change.

## Supersession

Which ADR this supersedes. The relation is recorded in `docs/adr/README.md`; do not edit an
accepted ADR to record it.
